name: World Chaos Map
what: Scores every country from 0 to 100 from the news, every four hours. 486 audited feeds, rule based, no manual overrides.
stack: TypeScript, React, Vite, MapLibre, Supabase, Postgres, GitHub Actions, Vercel

name: One Sentence
what: Strangers write a story together, one sentence each, seeing only the line before.

name: MaetriXs
what: A fitness tracker for your social life. Log real meetings, earn XP, grow a connection graph.

name: Public Opinion
what: A public sentiment layer for the internet. Ask, vote and watch opinion move in real time.

name: Last Drink
what: A drink tracker for nights out that rewards pacing. Hourly and nightly caps, water points, no progress bar.

name: LifeOS
what: Research programme on modelling how one person thinks and behaves. My final year project is the first piece.

name: Network Reconnaissance Detection
what: Research on catching the scanning phase of a cyberattack. A neural network trained on about 250,000 labelled network flows from UNSW-NB15.
line: Can a neural network spot an attacker quietly mapping a network, before the breach? About 250,000 labelled flows. Readings soon.

name: Loan Approval
what: Predicts which loan applications get declined, and the maximum loan for approved clients, across 58,645 applications. kNN caught the most declined loans.
line: Which loans get declined, and how much can the rest borrow? Six models on 58,645 applications.

name: Sky Portal
what: Portal for an engineering org: teams, messages, meetings, and a network map of team dependencies.
line: A Django portal for an engineering org, with a live network map of which teams depend on which.

name: Smart Campus API
what: REST API for campus rooms, sensors and nested sensor readings.
line: A REST API for rooms, sensors and their readings. JAX-RS on embedded Jetty, nothing but memory.

name: VerumVeil
what: Hide messages in plain sight with three password based ciphers: AI Sentence Crypt, SkipCode and Emoji Crypt.

name: Nuntius
what: Explored email spoofing through a web form. Retired once SPF, DKIM and DMARC blocked delivery.
line: Explored email spoofing through a small web form. Retired once SPF, DKIM and DMARC bounced every message, which was the lesson.

name: ClimateWatch
what: A site on climate action with accounts, sign up and login. Looking back, my first attempt at watching the world.
line: A PHP site on climate action, with sign up and login. Looking back, the first sketch of watching the world.

name: Movie Barcode
what: Turns any video into a barcode of its colours, one stripe per frame.
line: Turns any video into a barcode of its colours, one stripe per frame. Python, v1.5.

name: ModSec WAF
what: Script that turns a Linux VM into a web application firewall, tested in a three machine lab.
line: One script that turns a Linux VM into a web application firewall. Tested with a target, a WAF and an attacker on one network.

name: Battleship
what: Console Battleship against the computer, with sea monsters: the Kraken eats your score, Cetus moves every unsunk ship. Group project at Brunel.
line: Battleship in the terminal, plus sea monsters. Hit the Kraken and it eats your score. Hit Cetus and every ship moves.
